subject: Re: Status: Evalline integration live, de-dup throughput risk
body:
Gustavo, all — decisions.

De-dup: GPU-batch the embedding stage rather than dropping to hash-only. Cross-client leakage is the one flaw that would invalidate the benchmark, so we spend 8 A100s for a week rather than weaken detection — Emeka confirmed the batching change is two days of work.

Readout scope for Jul 17: public splits fully integrated (Landmarks plus both iNaturalist partitionings); partner imagery included only if it clears de-dup and QA by Jul 13 — otherwise it's a Q3 follow-on and we say so plainly.

Halima, lead the analysis section with the IID-versus-user-partition gap; that's the argument for making this suite the default in Evalline. And book Tomas for the readout — adoption is his call as much as ours.

Ximena
